title: Carrot Crunch Club | Healthy Eating Rhyme for Kids | BuBu TV - English
description:
Join the Carrot Crunch Club as the veggies cheer on little sister to try her beans!
A fun, bouncy rhyme that teaches kids why eating vegetables helps them grow up strong.
Sing along, crunch along, and make your own muscles like the beans do!

Open the door, open the fridge door wide
Carrot, cucumber, bean say hi!
Crunch, crunch, crunch, we're ready to play
The Carrot Crunch Club is here today!

Crunch, crunch, eat your veggies
Crunch, crunch, grow up strong
Munch, munch, munch, munch
Carrot Crunch Club, sing along!

Little sister shakes her head
"No, no, I don't like beans!"
Wiggle, wiggle, wiggle, wiggle
The bean looks sad and frowns

Crunch, crunch, eat your veggies
Crunch, crunch, grow up strong
Munch, munch, munch, munch
Carrot Crunch Club, sing along!

The veggie club does a dance
Bean shows off his big green arm
Boing, boing, boing, boing
Look how strong, strong, strong!

Crunch, crunch, eat your veggies
Crunch, crunch, grow up strong
Munch, munch, munch, munch
Carrot Crunch Club, sing along!

Little sis takes a tiny bite
Crunch, crunch, one green bean
Flex, flex, she makes a muscle too
Eat your veggies, grow up strong!
